text: PR #6505 (#6047 storage-layer _NullFlags) merged as c8dac41b0, issue closed. The Codex+Copilot review round's 15 findings were all real -- fixed 13, disclosed 2 as out-of-scope exceptions (memo NULL, COPY TO string-path NULL loss); confirmed root cause was read_raw_field_descriptors() never decoding the nullable flags byte (separate function from the already-correct parse_dbf_field_descriptor_block()), masked by the original test's own broken guard (values.size()==4U could never match a real 5-value record). Owner decided not to hand off to Codex mid-investigation; fixed solo. Docs PRs #6507/#6508 closed as superseded; #6510 open recording final handoff. #5631/#5567/#6047 -- all three prerequisites #6496's migration-fidelity campaign expected to hit -- are now fixed and merged. #6496 is next; #6506 (PrgValue/VARTYPE/EMPTY/NVL/EVL/aggregate-NULL redesign) filed as a follow-up, not started.
